comment: Canonical Whisper Protocol deployment IDs per network. Machine-readable so CI can update it without reformatting tricks. Each entry is the latest published deployment; older deployments are retained in git history.

localnet.note: Localnet IDs are intentionally null — every developer regenerates them via `sui start --force-regenesis` + republish. Pass explicit IDs to WhisperClient or set VITE_PACKAGE_ID / VITE_REGISTRY_ID for the demo dApp.

mainnet.note: Mainnet deploys are not automated. Populate manually with checklist.
